description: R-DEF-EXPR-SQL fixture r-def-expr-sql-mdb: tables One (one row), Dm (8 rows of G Text with a Null, V Double, N Long, S Text, DT Date/Time, with Nulls, duplicates, a quote and a padded value), Tx (38 rows of ID, a Text(255) column T and a Memo column M holding the same edge value: embedded and leading and trailing U+0000, odd-byte BSTRs, lone surrogates in both orders, an astral pair, U+FEFF, U+FFFE, trailing, no-break and zero-width spaces, a soft hyphen, compatibility and case forms, empty and Null) and U (ID Long primary key, K Text(50) with a unique index UX_U_K, empty). MDB (Jet 4 format) created by DBEngine.CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion40); values are stored through table-type AddNew/Value/Update; the closed file is kept.

args.text: CREATE TABLE One (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_One PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TABLE Dm (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Dm PRIMARY KEY, G TEXT(10), V DOUBLE, N LONG, S TEXT(20), DT DATETIME)
CREATE TABLE Tx (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_Tx PRIMARY KEY, T TEXT(255), M MEMO)
CREATE TABLE U (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_U PRIMARY KEY, K TEXT(50))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_U_K ON U (K)
